blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Justice (DOJ) has tossed out the obstruction of justice case filed against one of the lawyers of gaming tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang in connection with the departure of many witnesses from the case on the disappearance of missing “sabungeros” (cockfighting enthusiasts). In an interview with reporters, DOJ spokesperson Polo Martinez on Tuesday said that a panel of prosecutors has dismissed the charges against Caroline Cruz, lawyer of Ang, and three others alleged to be in connivance with the camp of the businessman to convince witnesses and other families of the missing sabungeros to walk out […]...
